CarWarningFlag.title: CarWarningFlag
CarWarningFlag.description: One of the car's own warning flags: its latest state (0 = all clear).

ChangePoints.title: ChangePoints
ChangePoints.description:
The car's consumption cut into periods of constant level (M65), from all its data; a change point is
where one segment ends and the next begins. One segment = no change found.

Comeback.title: Comeback
Comeback.description: After a fault stopped being listed, how soon it was read out again (M67), for every fault ever listed.

DataGap.title: DataGap
DataGap.description: A silence between two consecutive status reports.

DataHealth.title: DataHealth
DataHealth.description:
How much the loaded data can be trusted in a period (PLAN.md M46). Nothing here is a judgement of
the car: it describes the exports.

DataKind.title: DataKind
DataKind.description: One kind of export file (named as in Mazda's file names) and what it covers in the period.

DayEntry.title: DayEntry
DayEntry.description:
One thing that happened on a day. `kind` says which fields are filled: drive, status, doors, warning,
readout, alarm, fill_up, diag, alert, service.

DiagHistoryPoint.title: DiagHistoryPoint
DiagHistoryPoint.description: One diagnostic report, summarised so reports made at different times can be compared.

DrivingPattern.title: DrivingPattern
DrivingPattern.description: Stretches of driving (between two consecutive status reports) by length.

Forecast.title: Forecast
Forecast.description:
What the recent pace says about the oil change and the year's distance. Everything is counted from
`as_of`, the newest day with data, never from today.

FrameVoltage.title: FrameVoltage
FrameVoltage.description: The supply voltage recorded with faults (M68), by engine state, with a trend when there are enough frames.

FuelPayment.title: FuelPayment
FuelPayment.description: A payment in the fuel log that no fill-up was seen around.

Garage.title: Garage
Garage.description:
One car's headline figures for the "All cars" page. State figures (alerts, faults, oil, car warnings)
are the latest; the distance is for the 30 days up to the newest day with data.

ImportSummary.title: ImportSummary
ImportSummary.description: What one upload changed: the Mac only (the phone gets packs).

InvalidSignal.title: InvalidSignal
InvalidSignal.description: A signal the car flagged Invalid at least once (the dashboard never trusts such a reading).

ModelBody.title: ModelBody
ModelBody.description:
A model's outer dimensions (mm) and steering side, from `body:` in its model.yaml. The 3D drawing of the
car uses them; a dimension that is not given is drawn in proportion to a generic car.

ModelUnit.title: ModelUnit
ModelUnit.description: A control unit the owner placed in `layout.yaml`: a zone, or a position as fractions of the car.

MonthMetrics.title: MonthMetrics
MonthMetrics.description: One calendar month. Metrics are None when the month has no data for them (a gap, not 0).

OilService.title: OilService
OilService.description: The car's own countdown to the next oil change (not a calculation).

OilStep.title: OilStep
OilStep.description: A change of the car's oil countdown (the car counts in coarse steps).

Refuel.title: Refuel
Refuel.description:
A fill-up: a rise of the fuel level between two consecutive status snapshots (PLAN.md M47). When it
happened is only known to lie between the two.

Routines.title: Routines
Routines.description: The stretches grouped into the car's recurring kinds of stretch (M66), from all its data.

ServiceSuggestion.title: ServiceSuggestion
ServiceSuggestion.description: Something the data hints at that the log does not have; offered, never added.

TireReading.title: TireReading
TireReading.description: One tire-pressure MEASUREMENT (snapshots that repeat it are folded into it).

UnusualReports.title: UnusualReports
UnusualReports.description:
The reports of the period least like the car's other reports (M64); what is usual comes from all the
data. Never a fault.

WarningEpisodes.title: WarningEpisodes
WarningEpisodes.description:
Warnings grouped into episodes and recurring patterns (M63). Patterns are learned from all the data;
the period decides which episodes are counted.

WarningFlag.title: WarningFlag
WarningFlag.description: One of the car's 128 warning-lamp bit flags (only flags that ever change are listed).

WarningFlagHints.title: WarningFlagHints
WarningFlagHints.description: What happens around the times a flag is on. A hint to research from, NOT a meaning.
